verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's product page explicitly claims organization-wide CI/CD runs on hosted or private runners "with centralized visibility across pipeline status, testing policies, deployment environments and more." This is reinforced by built-in Pipelines and CI/CD policy enforcement across all teams and repositories. However, the support is marketing-level only. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the org-wide dashboard (cross-repo run views, filtering, history), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
